title: Parameter coercion, localized error messaging, and debug tooling playbook for tool/function calls
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define a pragmatic, production-ready approach for JSON schema-driven parameter coercion, localized human-facing error messages, and developer debug tooling for Redwood's tool/function calling surface. This ticket captures proposed coercion modes, error code taxonomy, telemetry hooks, compatibility shim behavior for v1 manifests, and acceptance criteria for rollout in the runtime and SDKs.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime implements three coercion modes: strict, permissive, guided-with-hints
Error responses include stable error_code, user_facing_message (localized), and optional example_remediation
SDKs surface a consistent programming contract for choosing coercion mode and receiving structured errors
Compatibility shim supports legacy v1 tool manifests with transformation rules and emitted warnings
CLI debug tool 'call-replay' can re-run calls with original context and show step-by-step coercion decisions
End-to-end tests (unit + fuzz) demonstrate <=0.1% increase in downstream failures for typical workloads when permissive mode enabled
decisions: Adopt three-mode coercion model (strict|permissive|guided) rather than per-field heuristics to keep runtime predictable.
Return a small, stable set of error_codes (INVALID_TYPE, REQUIRED_MISSING, COERCION_FAILED, OUT_OF_RANGE, UNKNOWN_FIELD) to simplify client mapping and i18n.
Emit localized user_facing_message on API responses; SDKs will map codes to locale templates and surface example_remediation when available.
Compatibility shim will run as a pre-validator and emit WARNINGS telemetry for fields that required transformation; it will not auto-upgrade manifest versions without explicit opt-in.
Telemetry event sample includes: call_id, model, route, coercion_mode, error_codes[], latency_ms, resolution (auto-coerced|failed|user-corrected).
next_steps: Finalize error_code list and canonical i18n templates (owner: localization guild)
Implement permissive-mode path in runtime with opt-in header for hosted customers
Ship SDK helpers to convert error_code -> localized message and to attach example_remediation snippets
Add CLI 'call-replay' MVP that can run recorded calls in sandbox mode and print coercion trace
Create fuzz corpus generator for common parameter shapes and run nightly tests against runtime+shim
